prompts.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent PNG mascot pose for the JarvisOS app. From the supplied contact sheet, extract ONLY the LARGE standard Bubu character on the LEFT (the large robot with two open green eyes). This is a faithful cutout of the existing illustration, not a redesign. Preserve its exact pose, leaf sprout, silhouette, face, colors, shading and original illustration style. Remove the cream background and ALL other characters, ground shadow, decorative sparkles and detached marks. Preserve the complete leaves and feet, crisp natural antialiased edges and true alpha transparency, with no white fringe. Place the isolated character on a 512x512 square transparent canvas, preserving aspect ratio, horizontally centered and feet at y=468, character height about 432 pixels. No labels, no added text, no new details, no extra object, no checkerboard pattern.
